issues.title: Employee record still shows inactive supervisor in SQL
issues.description: When a supervisor is made inactive without re-assigning their people, SQL still shows the inactive supervisor in the employee records until the employee record is resaved.

issues.title: Home Screen email - two step process
issues.description:
When clicking email from the home screen, either for everyone or individually, make it a two-step process. 
1. click email
2. confirm window
   -- Everyone - "Do you want to send email to everyone who has not reported?"
              OR
    -- Individual person -  "Do you want to send a reminder email to [persons name]?"
